PLAINTIFF’S NOTICE OF WITHDRAWAL OF ECF NO. 26
AND REQUEST TO VACATE SEPTEMBER 25, 2026 HEARING
AS TO ECF NO. 26 ONLY

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine, proceeding pro se, hereby
withdraws, in its entirety, Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Supplemental Complaint Pursuant to
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 15(d) (ECF No. 26), and requests that the September 25, 2026
hearing be vacated as to ECF No. 26 only. In support of this Notice, Plaintiff states as follows:

1. ECF No. 26 is Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Supplemental Complaint
Pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 15(d), filed August 21, 2026. By docket entry dated
August 25, 2026, the Court set ECF No. 26 for hearing on September 25, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., in
Alexandria Courtroom 301, before Magistrate Judge Ivan D. Davis, together with a separate

motion, Plaintiff’s Motion Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(d)(1) for Leave to Serve

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document57 _ Filed 09/08/26 Page 2 of 7 PagelD# 480

Three Limited Interrogatories on NCMEC Before the Rule 26(f) Conference (ECF No. 15). See
ECF Nos. 17, 28.

2. On September 3, 2026, Defendant Meta Platforms, Inc. filed its opposition to ECF
No. 26. ECF No. 53. In that filing, Meta objects that ECF No. 26 attached only Plaintiff’s
supplemental allegations, incorporating the remainder of the First Amended Complaint by
reference, rather than a copy of the proposed pleading in its entirety. ECF No. 53 at 3 n.1.

3. Plaintiff has elected to eliminate that procedural issue rather than litigate it. Plaintiff
is contemporaneously filing Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Second Amended and
Supplemental Complaint Pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 15(a)(2) and 15(d), which
presents one complete, integrated proposed pleading containing all amended and supplemental
matter. Plaintiff does not concede that Meta’s objection is correct.

4. Plaintiff therefore withdraws ECF No. 26 in its entirety. Plaintiff requests that the
Clerk terminate ECF No. 26 as a pending motion and that the Court vacate the September 25, 2026
hearing as to ECF No. 26 only. The withdrawal has the following docket consequences, and no
others:

(a) ECF No. 26 is withdrawn in its entirety;

(b) the September 25, 2026 hearing is to be vacated only insofar as that hearing

concerns ECF No. 26;

(c) ECF No. 15 remains pending;

(d) the September 25, 2026 hearing on ECF No. 15 remains scheduled and unchanged;

(e) Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to Appear Remotely at the September 25, 2026

Hearing (ECF No. 41) remains pending insofar as it concerns ECF No. 15;

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document57 _ Filed 09/08/26 Page 3 of 7 PagelD# 481

(f) Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Sur-Reply (ECF No. 43) remains pending and

unaffected; and

(g) all other settings relating to ECF No. 15 remain unchanged.

5. ECF No. 15 is a separate motion under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(d)(1) and
is fully briefed. ECF Nos. 15, 16, 31, 33, 36, 46, 52. Nothing in this Notice withdraws, modifies, or
otherwise affects ECF No. 15, the briefing on ECF No. 15, or the September 25, 2026 hearing on
ECF No. 15.

6. Because the September 25, 2026 hearing was set by the Court’s docket entry,
Plaintiff submits a proposed order with this Notice so that the hearing is vacated as to ECF No. 26
only.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court recognize the withdrawal of
ECF No. 26, vacate the September 25, 2026 hearing as to ECF No. 26 only, and leave the
September 25, 2026 setting for ECF No. 15 unchanged. A proposed order is submitted with this

Notice.

Date: September 7, 2026 Respectfully submitted,

—rD

Marvelle J. Ballentine
